summary.en: Miki Fujino is found strangled at the park. Takagi then finds a stamp card on the ground next to the victim's body and realises it doesn't belong to the victim as she has one in her purse. They then decide to do a stakeout the next day. Cause of death: Blunt head trauma & strangulation Suspects: Café Wheat and Beans customers and staffs However, while buying food at convenience store, Chiba is spotted by Detective Boys, so he has no choice but to bring them along to the stakeout. The stakeout this time also includes Kayo Mayuzumi, a woman who happened to discover the body and see the culprit but couldn’t give an exact description of that person’s face. While looking at the Café Wheat and Beans, they notice a man wearing sunglasses and a mask that looks very suspicious, so the boys quickly go there much to the surprise of the others. However, it turns out that he just wants to confirm if his wife is cheating, only to find out that she has just been meeting with one female friend. Later at sunset, it is also revealed that Mayuzumi is farsighted while Conan and Takagi notice a person whose dressing is almost identical like the previous person and he happens to not have a stamp card, but in reality he just wants to shop at that store in peace because he is a celebrity named Ryo Naruoka. So they end up going home to have rest before tomorrow's stakeout. However, Conan remembers that Mayuzumi is actually farsighted, which means that she was shocked to see someone else that could actually be the real culprit.
